plan.title: Single Stage Price Cap Column Validation

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable the tenant capability required for the Price Cap column.
Set the event type to RFQ and retain the default whole-lot awarding mode.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet can be populated.
Add the specified product and allow its mapped Variant 1 value to populate.
Enter the requested quantity.
Select the specified delivery location.
Open the product sheet's extra-column selector.
Add the Price Cap column to the sheet.
Enter the valid cap value.
Verify that 100 is retained without a cell error.
Try a non-numeric price cap.
Verify that letters are rejected by the sheet.
Try a negative price cap.
Verify that the negative value is rejected.
Assert the required negative-cap validation message.
Commit a valid schedule so publish reaches price-cap validation.
Add the required participant before attempting to publish.

args.because: Please enter valid price cap values
